context_diary: User previously asked for total users in the app; I found 10,000 total accounts. User then asked for agent count specifically; I filtered by type=agent and found 1,498 agents. Today, user requested 10 random agents with full details; I retrieved 10 agents from the database (IDs 10, 28, 40, 41, 45, 47, 57, 58, 62, 71) showing all are ACTIVE with mixed currencies — 5 TRY, 3 USD, 1 GBP, 1 EUR. Usernames follow pattern of name/initials with ID suffix, emails from various providers (gmail, icloud, yahoo, outlook, hotmail), and creation dates spanning late 2025 to early 2026.
